faber283n.name: Faber-Castell 2/83N
faber283n.description: Novo-Duplex arrangement with coloured C/CF and A/B/W bands, a W1/W2 root face, inverse scales in red, and self-documenting formula captions.
faber283n.instrumentNote: W₁/W₁′ cover the first square-root branch; W₂/W₂′ cover the second. Formula captions echo the 2/83N self-documenting style. The cursor includes front circle-area and 360 marks; its remaining auxiliary lines are not fully reconstructed.

thorntonAA010.name: Thornton AA010 / P221
thorntonAA010.description: Comprehensive Thornton arrangement with Ps/Pt, paired direct and inverse correction scales, folded scales and three positive plus three inverse log-log ranges.
thorntonAA010.instrumentNote: Correction rows ISd/ITd and Td/Sd are normalised layout studies, not calibrated Thornton correction scales. The ordinary arithmetic, root, trig and log-log scales use their stated mathematical mappings.

keDecilon.name: K&E 68-1100 Deci-Lon
keDecilon.description: A Deci-Lon layout study with compact Lon/log-log banks, Sq1/Sq2 roots, folded and reciprocal scales, and the characteristic clean K&E cream-and-red engraving.
keDecilon.instrumentNote: The scale order follows the published Deci-Lon families. This preset is included chiefly as a legibility reference: restrained numerals, strong index hierarchy, and clear opposing C/D baselines.

pickettN3.name: Pickett N3-T / N3-ES
pickettN3.description: Catalogued N3 arrangement: two full-length square-root and three cube-root branches on one face, with paired natural-exponential LL0+/− through LL3+/− rows on the other.
pickettN3.instrumentNote: On the log-log face, each black e^(+kD) reading and its red reciprocal e^(−kD) are printed against the same graduation. The square-root branches share a back-to-back line; the cube-root bank has an unruled upper branch and a shared middle/lower line.

pickettN4.name: Pickett N4-T / N4-ES
pickettN4.description: Catalogued N4 arrangement: compact cube- and square-root banks, paired S/Cos and tangent graduations, plus Pickett syncro log-log and hyperbolic scales.
pickettN4.instrumentNote: The root face uses Pickett back-to-back root banks. On the Syncro face, each black 10^(+kD) value and its red reciprocal 10^(−kD) share one physical tick. DF/M and CF/M fold at ln(10), so the same LL rows also work in base e.

pickettN16.name: Pickett N16-ES Electronics
pickettN16.description: Scientific face plus an electronics-labelled layout study. The specialist reverse is not a calibrated electrical calculator.
pickettN16.instrumentNote: Electronics reverse: layout study only, not an electrical calculator. Its phase, dB and circuit rows are illustrative mappings and are not calibrated to work together. The scientific face uses the stated mathematical mappings.

blackbody17.name: Pickett Model 17 Blackbody Radiation
blackbody17.description: Two-face blackbody calculator with energy and photon quantities, Kelvin/Celsius/Fahrenheit scales, dual wavelength/wavenumber branches, normalised Planck curves and cumulative radiation fractions.
blackbody17.instrumentNote: Align the red T index at the centre of M(Hλm) or M(Qλm) with the required temperature. Read the matching λ₁/λ₂ branch at the cursor; black and red paired rows represent the short- and long-wavelength branches.

thorntonF5100.name: Thornton / Blundell Harling F5100 Radiation
thorntonF5100.modelLabel: A.G. Thornton F5100 · Radiation slide rule
thorntonF5100.description: Lettered F5100 radiation layout: PHOTONS g–e above the slide, ENERGY d–a below it, the h–m energy slide, n–s photon reverse, and the wavelength/wavenumber/electron-volt reference scales.
thorntonF5100.instrumentNote: Layout study only: the F5100 letter order is retained, but its moving wavelength and curve rows do not reproduce the original calculation geometry. Fixed temperature-derived and reverse wavelength / wavenumber / photon-energy references are valid individually. Use Model 17 for the documented temperature-to-Planck-ratio workflow.

aristo0971.name: Aristo 0971 HyperboLog
aristo0971.description: Twenty-five rows: hyperbolic sine and tangent, paired sine/cosine and tangent/cotangent, folded arithmetic and six log-log ranges.
aristo0971.instrumentNote: Documented 0971 row order and main mathematical intervals. Sh1 and Th use D as 0.1 to 1; Sh2 uses D as 1 to 10. Red angular readings are complements. Th stops at argument 3. The cursor includes the documented circle, metric-PS and 36 conversion marks. End extensions and the full original gauge inventory are not reproduced.

aristo0972.name: Aristo 0972 HyperLog
aristo0972.description: Thirty-one rows: hyperbolic sine, cosine and tangent, H1/H2 hypotenuse ranges, Pythagorean P, paired trigonometry, folded arithmetic and eight log-log ranges.
aristo0972.instrumentNote: Documented 0972 row order and main mathematical intervals. H1/H2 read sqrt(1+x^2) at x on D (0.1 to 1 / 1 to 10). Ch gives the argument of cosh. Red angular readings are complements. Th stops at argument 3. The cursor includes the documented circle, metric-PS and 36 conversion marks. End extensions and the full original gauge inventory are not reproduced.

faber284n.name: Faber-Castell 2/84N Mathema
faber284n.description: Mathema duplex with extended decimal y/Y scales, calibrated auxiliary cursor marks, parabolic and Pythagorean scales, gon circular and hyperbolic functions, six log-log rows and two linear exponential rows.
faber284n.instrumentNote: Mathema 2/84N: the principal y/Y decade is 0.1–1, with engraved end extensions. Circular and hyperbolic arguments use gon (100 gon = 90°). For an exponential, subtract the chosen cursor mark’s constant from the argument, align that mark with the remainder on the appropriate exponential row, then multiply the main-hairline Y reading by the marked power of ten; the X mark has constant zero. The π/4 mark serves the quadratic rows; the two outer long hairlines provide the π/2 factor on Y. See the Mathema guide for examples and the scope of the reproduction.

ultralog.name: UltraLog - Zvi Doron design
ultralog.description: Forty separately ruled rows: eight log-log ranges, a wide hyperbolic/logarithmic slide, expanded square/cube roots and trigonometric/hypotenuse scales.
ultralog.instrumentNote: Mathematical implementation of Zvi Doron’s published 40-row proposal, not a production facsimile. No back-to-back rows. Const contains explicitly emulator-supplied mathematical references: the original inventory could not be verified. Source artwork is not included. See docs/ULTRALOG.md for attribution, source access and scope.

graphoplex690a.name: Graphoplex 690A Neperlog
graphoplex690a.description: Degree/minute trigonometry, eight natural log-log ranges, reciprocal and pi-folded arithmetic. Distinct from the hyperbolic 691A.
graphoplex690a.instrumentNote: Main index intervals from the supplied 690A photograph and Graphoplex manual. Angular captions use degrees/minutes/seconds, not decimal minutes. Conventional tick intervals are a mathematical reconstruction, not a tracing. The cursor follows the manufacturer-documented power and circle conversions. End extensions and the full original gauge inventory are not reproduced.

graphoplex691a.name: Graphoplex 691A Neperlog Hyperbolic
graphoplex691a.description: Decimal-degree trigonometry and Ch, Th, Sh2, Sh1 hyperbolic rows, with six natural log-log ranges on the reverse.
graphoplex691a.instrumentNote: Follows the supplied 691A specimen: Ch above A; Th, Sh2, Sh1 below D. The catalogue summary omits Ch and reverses Sh1/Sh2, so the photograph takes precedence. Main intervals and the manufacturer-documented cursor conversions; end extensions and specimen-specific extra markings are not reproduced.

faber282n.name: Faber-Castell 2/82N
faber282n.description: The 1962 N-model: paired tangent/cotangent and sine/cosine, movable S-prime and K-prime, reciprocal squares, folded arithmetic and six log-log ranges.
faber282n.instrumentNote: N-model main intervals from the manufacturer’s manual. S and S-prime multiply sine values; K and K-prime support cube calculations. Red angular readings are complements, not reciprocals. Original end extensions, every gauge mark and auxiliary cursor lines are not reproduced.

pickett14.name: Pickett Model 14 U.S. Military / Artillery
pickett14.description: General log-log face and degree/6400-mil trigonometric face. Shared complementary and supplementary angle ticks. Main index-to-index ranges, not a photographic facsimile.
pickett14.instrumentNote: Historical mathematical reconstruction. Degrees and 6400 mils/turn (not milliradians). Opposite-angle rows end at 90 degrees / 1600 mils; their supplementary readings run backwards. Original end extensions are omitted. Not a ballistic or fire-control calculator.

flyingFish1017.name: Flying Fish 1017 - Chemical engineering
flyingFish1017.description: Separate 1017 layout: chemical front with Mz/Xz and M/X, temperature, pressure, steam and near-unity log-log scales; scientific back with reciprocal log-log, A, lg, tangent/cotangent, sine/cosine, CI and C/D. Modern chemical calibrations.
flyingFish1017.instrumentNote: Flying Fish 1017: chemical front, scientific back. Photographed row arrangement; modern chemistry and gas models, not a certified historical calibration. Both sides keeps their cursor and slide linked.

front.name: Front - chemical engineering
front.note: Mz/Xz is fixed; M/X moves. Xz is mass fraction and X mole fraction. Pressure is absolute: kgf/cm2 and mmHg/atm. F(t) uses modern air/CO2 models. The outer LnI-2/Ln-2 rows are near-unity exponentials, not linear logarithms.

back.name: Back - scientific calculation
back.note: Ln and LnI are natural-exponential log-log scales (positive and reciprocal), despite the different scale names. The lg row is the linear base-10 logarithm. Normalised 0-1 rule length; original end extensions and specialist gauge marks are not transcribed.

hemmi257.name: Hemmi 257 - Chemical engineering
hemmi257.description: Hemmi 257-inspired duplex: chemical reference marks, compact M/X concentration scales, temperature, pressure, ice/steam and ideal-gas adiabatic scales. Modern data, not a photographic or historical-calibration facsimile.
hemmi257.instrumentNote: Choose Both sides for cross-face calculations. Chemical scales use modern data; the F(t) gas fits are not the original Hemmi calibrations.

back.name: Back - chemical engineering
back.note: Ch: underline x1, plain x10, overline x100 on D. M1/M2 settings must use the same decade; Xw and X are fractions, not percentages. F(t): air left, CO2 right; modern ideal-gas model. See Chemical scales help for procedures and limits.

fifths.name: Pickett-style fifth roots and powers
fifths.description: Five increasing fifth-root branches in one back-to-back bank, plus a shared-tick x^5 / x^(-5) row. Fixed on the front; movable on the back alongside square and cube root banks.
fifths.instrumentNote: A mathematical extension of Pickett-style engraving, not a historical model. For N = m times 10^k, choose fifth-root branch 1 + (k mod 5) and multiply its reading by 10^floor(k/5). The red fifth-power reading is the true reciprocal of the black one.

front.name: Front · fixed fifth roots and powers

back.name: Back · movable fifths with square and cube roots

comprehensive.name: Full scientific complement
comprehensive.description: Every built-in mathematical family on two programmable faces: core, reciprocal, folded, square/cube/fifth powers, expanded roots, trig, hyperbolic and ten aligned log-log ranges.
comprehensive.instrumentNote: A large laboratory layout rather than a replica. Use the rail editors to remove or reorder scales.

classic.name: Classic log-log duplex
classic.description: A compact generic layout with A/B/C/D/K/L, folded and reciprocal scales, trig scales and the four most-used positive and inverse LL ranges.

roots.name: Roots and powers laboratory
roots.description: Dedicated square-, cube- and fifth-root branches together with direct and reciprocal square, cube and fifth-power scales.

loglog.name: Full log-log laboratory
loglog.description: All five e^x and five e^-x ranges, aligned by exponent decade, with C/CI and supporting logarithm scales.

trig.name: Trigonometric laboratory
trig.description: Circular-function layout with sine, cosine, split tangent, small-angle and Pythagorean scales.

hyperbolic.name: Hyperbolic laboratory
hyperbolic.description: Split sinh and hypotenuse ranges, tanh and inverse cosh, with C/D and log-log support.
